worldModel.supportedSurfaceLaw: HarnessAgentRun is the caller-facing product composition boundary. Mechanical incompatibilities provable from the exact Contract and caller-supplied composition inputs must fail before durable Run creation rather than leaving a Run that can never execute.
worldModel.effectOrdering: create() now orders effects as exact Contract/caller-input static admission -> caller-owned Adapter factory -> Adapter/Contract binding admission -> durable Run creation. Composition facts that do not require an Adapter fail before the factory; Adapter/model/structured-completion mismatches fail after the factory returns but before harness.run-created.
worldModel.staticOnlyLaw: Static admission does not probe Provider availability, Runtime liveness, external-world truth or semantic completion correctness. Those remain later physical/semantic authorities.
worldModel.cognitionAuthority: Cognition-enabled supported composition requires Contract model-content authority; WorkingSet-history composition additionally requires Tool-content authority. These are Contract authority facts, not Provider recommendations.
worldModel.runtimeBindingAuthority: The built-in Runtime-search surface mechanically checks the exact independent Run binding derivable from the Contract: harnessRunId, assignment identity/generation/digest, Tool catalog/grant, deadline and non-empty ordivon.harness runtime references. Workspace/runtime-binding content is not inferred.
worldModel.adapterBindingAuthority: Adapter identity/model and structured-completion Contract digest are admitted before durable Run creation. Provider choice remains caller policy because Harness only validates the Adapter returned by the caller factory.
worldModel.defenseInDepth: StandaloneHarnessRunner and concrete SQLite bridges retain their validation. R3.2 moves static supported-surface admission earlier without making lower layers trust the facade.
worldModel.compatibilityLaw: R3.2 changes effect ordering and failure timing for invalid supported compositions but does not remove low-level API exports or alter custom core composition.

cognitionPrivacyMismatch.lateFailure: Standalone cognition requires Contract permission to retain model content

structuredCompletionMismatch.lateFailure: Standalone Runner structured completion differs from its Contract

runtimeBindingMismatch.lateFailure: Harness Execution Binding differs from the independent Run binding

liveProviderAcceptance.networkProfile: ambient direct HTTPS after DNS/TCP preflight; loopback secondary was not reused after a separate 502 CONNECT failure
liveProviderAcceptance.callerExecutionPath: HarnessAgentRun.create -> run -> fresh HarnessAgentRun.open -> resume; no caller-supplied SQLite Store, Continuity, Bridge, RunBudget or provider_source

transportIncident.secondaryResult: The first R3.2 live attempt used the existing 127.0.0.1:19081 native-a CONNECT sidecar and received 502 Bad Gateway during CONNECT. Durable Provider recovery then required explicit resume.
transportIncident.handling: The uncertain Run was not retried or resumed. Sidecar process health was inspected separately; ambient DNS/TCP was then proven healthy and a fresh direct-path Run was used for live R3.2 acceptance.
transportIncident.significance: This is network-path evidence, not a static-composition failure, and confirms that R3.2 did not bypass existing Provider recovery semantics.

conclusion: R3.2 turns HarnessAgentRun.create into a reliable static composition admission boundary. Invalid cognition privacy/history authority and exact Runtime-binding inputs now fail before Adapter construction; Adapter/model/structured-completion mismatch fails before durable Run creation. Valid composition remains caller-owned and the recommended public handle completed a fresh real DeepSeek cognition pause/open/resume trajectory. The 298-test/full build gate passes.
knownLimits: Static admission proves only composition facts available from Contract and caller inputs. It does not prove Provider availability, Runtime liveness, external effects or caller/domain semantic success.
Automatic bridge composition remains limited to canonical no-Tool and the existing independent Runtime-search surface; custom/domain bridges remain advanced core composition.
The recommended API still exports 51 symbols including earlier low-level Store/Continuity/StandaloneRunner components for compatibility. Facade narrowing remains a later evidence-gated R3 question.
HarnessAgentRun remains per-Run composition, not cross-Run memory, orchestration or Provider recommendation.
The native-a loopback sidecar returned 502 during this R3.2 session; the final live acceptance therefore used the independently healthy ambient direct Provider path.
